title: German run_optimization_no_prices message reads {entry_id}; the raise passes {entry_ids}
claim: Of 4533 translated leaf strings compared with strings.json, exactly one names a different placeholder set: de exceptions.run_optimization_no_prices.message reads {entry_id} while services.py raises it with translation_placeholders={'entry_ids': ...}, so a German user who calls run_optimization with too few price steps gets a message whose entry placeholder is never filled.
mechanism: Translation drift: the de string was written with the singular placeholder name; strings.json, en and sv use {entry_ids}, matching the raise at services.py (translation_key='run_optimization_no_prices').

evidence.unit: placeholder-parity mismatches (and 1 raise with an unsupplied placeholder)
evidence.contention_note: box shared with other seats, load1 ~168; count is contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.services (run_optimization raise site, translation_key run_optimization_no_prices) and translations/de.json:exceptions.run_optimization_no_prices

perturbation.change: --perturb-fix-de: in memory, rename {entry_id} to {entry_ids} in the de message

metric_definition: Leaf strings in en/sv/de whose {placeholder} set differs from strings.json's at the same path; plus raise sites whose literal translation_placeholders lack a placeholder the message reads.
phenomenon_property: Every translated string names exactly the placeholders of its strings.json source, and every raise or form result supplies them.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub <HOME>/.local/state/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 -I dev/audit/rounds/round11/D4/s2/services_icons.py (PLACEHOLDER_PARITY over every leaf string; EXC_PLACEHOLDER over every services.py raise)

null_control.value: 4532 of 4533 leaf strings match; en and sv of the same key match
null_control.note: the other two languages of the same key are the in-file control

reproduction_steps: Run the command: PLACEHOLDER_PARITY de:exceptions.run_optimization_no_prices.message and EXC_PLACEHOLDER lines, both counts 1
proposed_fix_scope: Rename the placeholder in de.json to {entry_ids}; add the placeholder-parity check (every translation leaf vs strings.json) to the gate's translation tests.
